part.text: Read-only review of the privacy overlay v1 drivers — running its suite and checking sequencing.
Found the v1 drivers and v2 reference — executing the unit suite now.

Read-only review complete. Real driver was not executed (no SSH/VM).

**Tests executed (actual):**
`python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/php83/baseline-rehearsal/privacy/media-overlay-v1 -p "test_*.py" -v` → **18/18 pass** (10 in `test_guest.py`, 8 in `test_runner.py`), in ~0.001s.

**Scope verified against `guest.py` / `run.py` (static, no credentials output):**
- Sequencing: wrong-secret gate + audit (lines 77–81) precedes partner-secret SQL read (line 83); enforced by `test_secret_read_after_gate`. `user_attempted` checkpoint precedes KS send; `upload_attempted` checkpoint precedes upload; `media_window=(start,jstart)` is set before upload so the failure handler covers the full media window.
- Upload/entry/READY: single pinned synthetic file (`MEDIA_SOURCE_PIN`, ≤2 MB), upload-token shape check, owned entry via `media_projection`, `addContent`, READY poll bounded by `time.monotonic()+600`, sleep 2, poll count recorded, terminal states fail as `READY_NOT_REACHED`.
- Source binding: exactly one `isOriginal` asset, `version.isdigit()` (version 0 allowed by design), read-only `file_sync` SELECT with digit/ID/int-gated interpolation, single `owned_storage` candidate scoped under `/opt/kaltura/web/content`, `STORED_SOURCE_BYTES` SHA check plus `SOURCE_AFTER` re-check.
- Filtered list: `media.list` with `idEqual` + pager, `totalCount==1`, `typed_equal` projection identity.
- Source delivery GET: `Origin('192.168.56.74','http',80).validate(url)` (literal-74, userinfo/fragment refused at transport layer), guest-side `no query`, `no /ks/`, `secret/ks not in url`, then `deadline.get(..., limit=2 MB, deadline=30)` — redirects refused via `NoRedirects` plus response-URL revalidation; delivered bytes SHA-checked (`HTTP_SOURCE_BYTES`).
- Failure retention: `except` path attempts `media_failure_privacy` audit over `media_window`; scan errors recorded as class-only. Error codes bounded to fixed `[A-Z0-9_]` tokens (plus `Failed` family); no backend text/values exported. `run.py` forbids secret-bearing receipt keys (nested), preserves complete receipts on partial/timeout output.
- Bounded runtime: guest poll 600 s + 30 s operation deadlines inside `run.py` `RuntimeMaxSec=1100` / 1130 s SSH timeout; stage pinned (root-owned 0444, hash-verified), never-overwrite, `PENDING_REVIEW`/freeze/source drift gates before SSH, unit cleanup asserted.

**Blocking defects: none found** in this narrowed scope. Non-blocking notes only: `READY_NOT_REACHED` conflates timeout vs. terminal status into one code; guest depends on the pre-existing `/home/vagrant/privacy-application-overlay-v3` stage (fail-closed via manifest pin if absent); `originals` truthiness list conflates `True==1` but still rejects all non-original markers, matching the `untimed_driver.py` pattern. No benchmark/TLS/full-matrix claims in the reports.
